comments.tailwindcss: PINNED to 3.4.x, NOT a floating major. v3 core utilities emit literal declarations (padding: 1rem, rgb(255 255 255 / .1)) that crates/vn-css maps straight onto gpui; v4 routes everything through var(--tw-*) + calc() + @property, which the engine does not resolve yet, so a v4 bump would degrade nearly every utility to a diagnostic. See packages/vue-native/tailwind.ts.
comments.@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: devDependency, not a runtime one: it is used ONLY by devtools/mcp.ts (the vn-devtools MCP server, see docs/DEVTOOLS.md). Nothing in an app bundle imports it, and devtools/ctl.ts is deliberately dependency-free so an agent can drive the app through Bash without `bun install` having run.
comments.typescript: TYPE-CHECKING ONLY — `bun run typecheck`. Nothing in the build or the test path invokes tsc: bun transpiles src/*.ts directly (Bun.build for dist/, Bun.Transpiler for the test harnesses), so a missing `bun install` degrades to 'no type check', never to 'no build'. tsconfig.json is the contract.
